get_dataset_test_split: get the SmallNORB test split dataset with 5-class classification labels and images
get_dataset_train_split: get the SmallNORB train split dataset filtered by instance IDs for generalization testing
get_dataset_dev_split: get the SmallNORB dev split dataset using a single instance from the training set
get_dataset_with_slicing: get the SmallNORB dataset with outer_start and outer_end indices to slice the stream
review_get_dataset: review the get_dataset function that builds SmallNORB datasets with custom train dev and test splits
